summary: convolution-explorer written to src/widgets/convolution-explorer.js. Controls (DOM order): input image select (5), kernel preset select (9 incl. custom), nine kernel number inputs, normalise-to-sum-1 button (disabled at sum 0), flip checkbox, sliders p 0-3, s 1-3, d 1-3, previous/next/play/reset buttons, show-numbers checkbox; clicking an output cell jumps, arrow keys step. Default: worked example, edge kernel, p0 s1 d1, window at (0,0): Y[0,0]=-1 written as nine products; stepping fills [[-1,-4,0],[-3,-2,4],[-1,-2,1]]; flip negates. Checked against an independent NumPy implementation in 14 states (default, flip, letter F+Sobel-x p1, checkerboard+Gaussian p2 s2 d2, diagonal+box p3 s3 d3, worked d3 (no valid window, H_out=-1), step+sharpen s2 flip, worked+Laplacian p3 s3, letter F with edited custom weights p1 d2 flip, diagonal+Sobel-y, identity, Sobel-x flip, box p2 s2, step+edge d2 s3): all output values agree to 3 s.f., H_out and the never-read note (r) agree. en and zh tests: no errors, screenshots read.
issues: widget-test reports changedOutput=false for several controls (image select, weight inputs, flip, stride, show numbers) because it restores each control and measures only canvas hashes and innerText length, not SVG; the Python state comparison confirms they do change the output.
Interpretation: the current window's output cell is shown as already revealed (so the default shows -1 immediately); only later cells are cleared on reset.
